images.caption: In December 2005 a small two masted ship named the Carthaginian was intentionally sunk off the coast of Lahaina, Maui, Hawaii to form an artificial reef.  It is a popular target for divers to explore.  This is the forward hatch that goes below deck.  A part of the collapsed front mast is in the upper right corner of the picture.  I took this photograph through the view port of a submarine in April 2012.  The Carthaginian was built in the 1920s and was in use until the mid '70s.  The wreck sits on the floor of the ocean at a depth of 105 feet.
